title: Felt his body turn to stone while linked to a craft that was shot
place_text: undisclosed area near directed energy weapons

tellings.quote: it felt as if my body was actually turning to stone.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that once, while he was somehow linked to a craft that was then shot at, "it felt as if my body was actually turning to stone." He tells Michels this as something he went through himself, in an episode about being taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, and he places it in an undisclosed area near directed energy weapons, meaning weapons that fire beams of energy rather than bullets. If true, it would mean a person's own body could be tied to a craft closely enough to feel what happens to it.
